messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

Wireless-standard vector signal analysis is a supported capability, because R&S VSE supports mobile and wireless communications standards and is used for 5G NR, LTE, O-RAN U-Plane / PCAP analysis and beamforming measurements [1][2].
5G NR signal analysis is supported with presets for 5G NR test models and support of all 5G NR measurements [1].
LTE and 5G NR downlink/uplink measurement options are identified for VSE as VSE-K100, VSE-K104 and VSE-K144 [3].
O-RAN signal analysis is supported with VSE-K175, including predefined test signals according to the WG4.CONF.0 test specification [1][3].
O-RAN U-Plane analysis is supported because the O-RAN PCAP Converter can convert captured Ethernet streams into VSE file format and VSE analyzes U-Plane data in uplink and downlink [1].
Beamforming measurement capability is supported because VSE-K146 can display phase and magnitude difference in the summary for beamforming measurements [1][3].
Bitstream and channel-decoder-result extraction is supported because VSE can extract channel decoder results and bitstreams of 5G and LTE uplink and downlink signals [1].
EVM measurement is a key supported RF quality capability because EVM is defined as the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform in 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing [40][41].
For 5G NR EVM testing, measurement results must be below the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 maximum error percentage with the applicable test tolerance [42].
CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution [9][13].
CMX500 includes vector signal analysis and ARB generator capability for FR2 transmitter and receiver RF parametric testing [9].
CMX500 can perform 5G NR receiver tests under 3GPP fading propagation conditions using internal baseband fading emulation [9].
CMP180 supports production and wireless communication device testing with configurable multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [18].
CMP180 supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and provides a multiport RF test architecture with RF generator/analyzer no. 1 and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 [21].
CMP180 RF analyzer capabilities include 250 MHz IF bandwidth, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [23].
CMP180 RF analyzer capabilities include 0.1 Hz frequency resolution, expected nominal power setting range from –47 dBm to +38 dBm, level uncertainty down to ±0.3 dB from 400 MHz to 5000 MHz under stated conditions, and RX DANL below –157 dBm from 400 MHz to 6500 MHz under stated conditions [23].
FSWX supports spectrum, noise measurement, phase noise and modulation-quality EVM cross-correlation [50].
FSWX provides extended spurious-free dynamic range and improved displayed average noise level for finding hidden spurs [50].
FSWX multipath wideband phase-coherent receivers can perform simultaneous signal analysis and spectrum analysis with independent receivers [50].
FSWX can compare amplitude, frequency and phase between ports, including simultaneous H/V antenna polarization or device input/output measurements [50].
FSWX supports image-free I/Q and vector signal analysis using preselected capture and analysis to avoid unwanted-signal interference [50].
FSWX signal analysis bandwidth reaches up to 4 GHz per RF input and up to 8 GHz on RF input A with the listed bandwidth options [51].
High-speed digital signal-integrity validation capabilities in the corpus include interface test with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices [36][38].
High-speed digital signal-integrity validation capabilities also include RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators [36][38].
Power Distribution Network validation is listed as a signal-integrity-related test block using scopes and network analyzers [36][38].
ADC/DAC frontend performance validation is listed with spectrum analyzers and signal generators [36][38].
High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner and transmission-line calculator [36][38].
【推論】For wireless communication applications, the corpus supports combining wireless-standard vector signal analysis, EVM, O-RAN/beamforming analysis, multiport RF analysis, wideband spectrum analysis, jitter/clock validation and PCB channel validation as the main signal-integrity capability set, because these capabilities are separately documented for wireless test products and SI/PI validation flows.[1][2][18][23][36][38][40][50]

依 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023）：

- Slide 8 的 VIAVI + R&S O-RU Tester solution 中列出 [[R&S VSE]]。
- Slide 14 標題為 `R&S®VSE Signal analysis software`，描述為 PC analysis software。
- Slide 14 key facts：
  - Supports mobile and wireless communications standards。
  - Fast measurements with parallel analysis。
  - Supporting floating licenses。
  - Control multiple instruments from one PC。
- Slide 15 說 5G NR signal analysis 支援 presets for 5G NR Test models 與 support of all 5G NR measurements。
- Slide 26 說 3GPP Receiver characteristic testing requires throughput calculation，且 BLER 與 Tput parameters implemented to VSE software。
- Slide 35 說 signal analysis with option VSE-K175 有 pre-defined test signals according to WG4.CONF.0 test specification。
- Slide 36 說 VSE software can extract channel decoder results and bitstream of 5G and LTE uplink and downlink signals；beamforming measurements 可用 VSE-K146 在 summary 顯示 phase and magnitude difference。
- Slide 38 說 O-RAN PCAP Converter 可把 captured Ethernet stream 轉成 VSE file format，VSE analyzes the U-Plane data in UL and DL。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › FCC / ANSI C63.26 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE frequency ranges：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）或 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: TRP。
  - Early exit criteria for EIRP, TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance formula 在來源中 OCR 為 `≥ 2D2/`，公式不完整，需回查原文。
- 來源稱 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

5G FR2 RSE 測試
[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]是針對 5G FR2 devices 的 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]] 測試主題；[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）把它拆成 3GPP / FCC / ETSI requirements、TS8980 / TS8996 分工、FR2 signal conditioning、above-40-GHz extension 與 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] test workflow。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › Signal conditioning and frequency extension
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 5G FR2 carrier can be between 24.25 GHz and 50 GHz。
- UE Power class 3: max. TRP 23 dBm + antenna gain + crest factor。
- Without level adaptation, preamplifiers can overload and produce wrong results。
- [[TS-PRE1850]]：18 GHz to 40 GHz；40–50 GHz extension with [[TS-PRE-B1]]。
- 41 GHz to 325 GHz extension 使用 [[TC-RSE60]] / 90 / 140 / 220 / 325 receive units 與 [[TC-MX60]] / 90 / 140 / 220 / 325 multiplier units。
- TC-RSE units sensitivity EIRP（RMS detector）at 1 m test distance：< -40 dBm/MHz。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

EVM › 與 min power 的關係
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.3.1.3-1 定義 minimum power（Pmin）。
- Channel BW 3–20 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 dBm。
- Channel BW 25–100 MHz 的 minimum output power 為 -40 + 10log10(BW/20)。
- 256QAM Test IDs 的 target power 為 **Pmin + 10 dB**。
- 來源另以 100 MHz BW 說明 min power according to Table 6.3.1.3-1 略低於 33 dB；此處照來源摘要保留單位字樣，不自行改寫。

EVM › 與既有測試脈絡的關係
- [[FWA CPE]] 與 [[FWA CPE 測試與驗證]] 中的戶外高階 mmWave ODU DVT 項目列出 FR2 EVM，但來源未提供 EVM limit、測試配置或標準章節。
- [[Small Cell BTS 測試資料清單]] 保存 base station Tx / Rx / OTA tests 檔名，但附件未擷取，因此不能補充 EVM 測項。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 補入的是 NR-FR1 SA UE pre-conformance EVM PUCCH/PUSCH 脈絡，不等同 FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、base station 或 production-line EVM limits。

EVM › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 EVM measurement tutorial，也不是 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 標準全文。
- [[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開；[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只提供 selected NR-FR1 SA test case 摘要。
- 不可由此頁推論 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、LTE、NR 或 production line test 的所有 EVM limits。
- 任何正式 pass / fail limit 應回查對應標準、儀器文件、software version 與 test condition。

EVM › unresolved
- EVM 的完整公式、filtering、averaging、reference waveform 產生方式與 test equipment uncertainty 未由 [[WIC Glossary]] 提供。
- [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 只摘錄 selected 3GPP conformance limits；完整 tables 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]]。
- [[FWA CPE]] 中 FR2 EVM 的標準依據與測試條件未標示。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › 使用限制
- 本頁同時使用 [[CMX500_Callbox]]（Market / company restricted sales-training 簡報）與 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]（Knowledge / company confidential 技術筆記）。兩者都不能取代正式 [[R&S CMX500]] specifications、feature list、release note 或 3GPP 標準原文。
- 「supports all」屬 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 來源用語，需以正式 feature list、release note、3GPP scope 與 configurator 驗證。
- [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 但未標示版本；所有 xTyR、guard period、slot resource 限制需以正式 3GPP TS 38.214 對應版本核對。
- Receiver pre-adder / selection 的 implementation、receiver-chain allocation、calibration、measurement accuracy 與 UI / API 設定仍缺 formal source。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › Guard period 與 1T4R 限制
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，Tx switching transient time 需要兩個 SRS transmissions 之間的 minimum guard period：

| SCS | Guard period |
|---:|---:|
| 15 kHz | 1 symbol |
| 30 kHz | 1 symbol |
| 60 kHz | 2 symbols |
| 120 kHz | 2 symbols |

來源註明：UE 在 guard period 期間不傳送任何其他 signal。

來源並指出：由於一個 slot 最多可為 UE configure 6 symbols，1T4R antenna switching 因 guard period 資源不足，無法在一個 slot 內達成。此處是 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 對 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] antenna switching timing / resource 的說法；尚未由正式 3GPP 原文頁驗證。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS antenna switching 技術背景
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]：

- [[SRS antenna switching]] 讓 [[UE]] 可以將 SRS transmissions route 到其他可用 antenna ports。
- 若 UE 支援此 feature，[[gNB]] 可要求 UE 在不同 symbols across all downlink receive antennas 傳送 SRS，以 better calibrate [[MIMO]] channel 並 improve downlink SNR。
- 在 [[MIMO]] setup 中，UE 可能有比某個 physical signal 的 logical ports 更多的 physical antennas；UE 因此需要把 logical ports mapping 到可用 physical antennas 的 subset。
- UE 可能在不同 [[OFDM symbol]] 中以不同 physical antennas 傳送，因此需要隨時間切換 logical-to-physical port mapping。
- 來源稱 3GPP Release 15 的一個 use case 是 different SRS resources 的 SRS logical ports 在不同 OFDM symbols 中 transmission，以便從 UE 所有 physical transmit antennas 進行 channel sounding。

R&S FSWX › 產品定位與架構
- 產品定位：multiport signal and spectrum analyzer。
- 內部 multipath architecture 支援 1-port 與 2-port instruments。
- 可用於 spectrum、noise measurement、phase noise、modulation quality（EVM）的 [[Cross-correlation]]。
- 提供 extended [[Spurious free dynamic range]]（SFDR）。
- 改善 [[Displayed average noise level]]（DANL）以尋找 hidden spurs。
- 可在 high-power carrier 存在時量測 distortion 與 noise。
- 可針對 EVM 要求嚴苛的 components 做 characterization。
- Multipath wideband phase coherent receivers 可使用 independent receivers 同時進行 signal analysis 與 spectrum analysis。
- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。
- 可同時量測 antenna 的 H 或 V polarizations、device input 與 output，並直接比較 ports 之間的 amplitude、frequency、phase。
- Image free I/Q and vector signal analysis 使用 preselected capture and analysis，避免 unwanted signals 干擾量測。
- Operating system：Linux based operating system，目標為 high security 與 long-term support。

R&S FSWX › Signal analysis bandwidth
| 項目 | 規格 / 條件 |
|---|---|
| 每個 RF input | 最高 4 GHz bandwidth |
| RF input A | 最高 8 GHz bandwidth |
| Standard I/Q data maximum signal analysis bandwidth | 40 MHz（nom.） |

Wireless-standard vector signal analysis is a supported capability, because R&S VSE supports mobile and wireless communications standards and is used for 5G NR, LTE, O-RAN U-Plane / PCAP analysis and beamforming measurements [1][2].
5G NR signal analysis is supported with presets for 5G NR test models and support of all 5G NR measurements [1].
LTE and 5G NR downlink/uplink measurement options are identified for VSE as VSE-K100, VSE-K104 and VSE-K144 [3].
O-RAN signal analysis is supported with VSE-K175, including predefined test signals according to the WG4.CONF.0 test specification [1][3].
O-RAN U-Plane analysis is supported because the O-RAN PCAP Converter can convert captured Ethernet streams into VSE file format and VSE analyzes U-Plane data in uplink and downlink [1].
Beamforming measurement capability is supported because VSE-K146 can display phase and magnitude difference in the summary for beamforming measurements [1][3].
Bitstream and channel-decoder-result extraction is supported because VSE can extract channel decoder results and bitstreams of 5G and LTE uplink and downlink signals [1].
EVM measurement is a key supported RF quality capability because EVM is defined as the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform in 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing [40][41].
For 5G NR EVM testing, measurement results must be below the 3GPP TS 38.521-1 maximum error percentage with the applicable test tolerance [42].
CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD device testing as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution [9][13].
CMX500 includes vector signal analysis and ARB generator capability for FR2 transmitter and receiver RF parametric testing [9].
CMX500 can perform 5G NR receiver tests under 3GPP fading propagation conditions using internal baseband fading emulation [9].
CMP180 supports production and wireless communication device testing with configurable multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [18].
CMP180 supports simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and provides a multiport RF test architecture with RF generator/analyzer no. 1 and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 [21].
CMP180 RF analyzer capabilities include 250 MHz IF bandwidth, or 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 [23].
CMP180 RF analyzer capabilities include 0.1 Hz frequency resolution, expected nominal power setting range from –47 dBm to +38 dBm, level uncertainty down to ±0.3 dB from 400 MHz to 5000 MHz under stated conditions, and RX DANL below –157 dBm from 400 MHz to 6500 MHz under stated conditions [23].
FSWX supports spectrum, noise measurement, phase noise and modulation-quality EVM cross-correlation [50].
FSWX provides extended spurious-free dynamic range and improved displayed average noise level for finding hidden spurs [50].
FSWX multipath wideband phase-coherent receivers can perform simultaneous signal analysis and spectrum analysis with independent receivers [50].
FSWX can compare amplitude, frequency and phase between ports, including simultaneous H/V antenna polarization or device input/output measurements [50].
FSWX supports image-free I/Q and vector signal analysis using preselected capture and analysis to avoid unwanted-signal interference [50].
FSWX signal analysis bandwidth reaches up to 4 GHz per RF input and up to 8 GHz on RF input A with the listed bandwidth options [51].
High-speed digital signal-integrity validation capabilities in the corpus include interface test with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices [36][38].
High-speed digital signal-integrity validation capabilities also include RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators [36][38].
Power Distribution Network validation is listed as a signal-integrity-related test block using scopes and network analyzers [36][38].
ADC/DAC frontend performance validation is listed with spectrum analyzers and signal generators [36][38].
High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner and transmission-line calculator [36][38].
【推論】For wireless communication applications, the corpus supports combining wireless-standard vector signal analysis, EVM, O-RAN/beamforming analysis, multiport RF analysis, wideband spectrum analysis, jitter/clock validation and PCB channel validation as the main signal-integrity capability set, because these capabilities are separately documented for wireless test products and SI/PI validation flows.[1][2][18][23][36][38][40][50]

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

R&S FSWX › 產品定位與架構
- 產品定位：multiport signal and spectrum analyzer。
- 內部 multipath architecture 支援 1-port 與 2-port instruments。
- 可用於 spectrum、noise measurement、phase noise、modulation quality（EVM）的 [[Cross-correlation]]。
- 提供 extended [[Spurious free dynamic range]]（SFDR）。
- 改善 [[Displayed average noise level]]（DANL）以尋找 hidden spurs。
- 可在 high-power carrier 存在時量測 distortion 與 noise。
- 可針對 EVM 要求嚴苛的 components 做 characterization。
- Multipath wideband phase coherent receivers 可使用 independent receivers 同時進行 signal analysis 與 spectrum analysis。
- 可在 spectrum 任意位置、相同或不同頻率同時觀察 signals。
- 可同時量測 antenna 的 H 或 V polarizations、device input 與 output，並直接比較 ports 之間的 amplitude、frequency、phase。
- Image free I/Q and vector signal analysis 使用 preselected capture and analysis，避免 unwanted signals 干擾量測。
- Operating system：Linux based operating system，目標為 high security 與 long-term support。
